jsonld_raw.name: ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK ELIXIR PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ)
jsonld_raw.description:
ENERGETICALLY NEW YORK ELIXIR PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ). Energetically New York Elixir intensifies the magnetic energy of the city, amplifying its character and depth. Suede sandalwood provides an enveloping, warm softness that reinforces the composition's structure, while cardamom maintains its vibrant freshness and jasmine adds elegant luminosity. More concentrated and with a greater presence, it maintains the perfect balance between dynamism and sophistication.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody aquatic | Intense, enveloping, and sophisticated
